$comment: Mozilla's first-party Firefox DevTools MCP server —
Drives the BRANDED Firefox in /Applications over WebDriver BiDi, via Selenium and the
Homebrew geckodriver. That is the whole point: Playwright's `firefox` is a patched build,
so it cannot answer what real Firefox does with a real WebGPU pipeline.
⚠ OFF BY DEFAULT, deliberately. This file is NOT in enabledMcpjsonServers and belongs in no
project's .mcp.json. The `developer` preset is 45 tools; paying that in every session to use
it in a handful is the wrong trade. Load it per session instead:
claude --firefox          (the wrapper passes --mcp-config with this file)
⚠ NOT --headless, and that is load-bearing. Measured 2026-09-02 on this machine:
headless Firefox resolves navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() to NULL, so a headless run cannot
see WebGPU at all. Headed returns a real adapter (texture-compression-bc, timestamp-query,
maxTextureDimension2D 32767). A window has to appear for the GPU to.
`developer` is the preset that carries list_console_messages, list_network_requests and the
Gecko profiler; the default `basic` preset has none of the three.
Pinned like every other stdio server here — @latest would re-resolve the supply chain on
every launch. npx rather than bunx because the server is Selenium-backed and Mozilla
documents Node (>= 20.19); this machine's node is what the probe ran against.
